crossRefs.note: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.

translations.web: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
translations.bsb: So those who were sent went out and found it just as Jesus had told them.
translations.kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
translations.asv: And they that were sent went away, and found even as he had said unto them.
